units.source_text: 非常遗憾，我没有看到有为子决心背叛时的那张变形的脸。

en.t: Regrettably, I did not see the distorted face Yuko wore when she resolved to betray me.

units.source_text: 如果我仔细端详一番，也许我会萌生宽恕他人之心，包括宽恕所有丑恶之心。

en.t: If I had studied it closely, perhaps a heart capable of forgiving others would have arisen in me, even a heart capable of forgiving all ugliness.
